refnamediv.refpurpose: set bitflags for various weapons behavior

row.entry: FLAG
DESCRIPTION
Disable Sten overheating
Disable Mobile MG42 overheating
Allow headshots with Mobile MG42
Allow players to fire while leaning (1st person view and 3rd person animation are modified if this option is enabled)
Allow Medics and Engineers to pick Sten in limbo
Fire underwater (except flamers, panzers, rifle grenades, mortars and MG42)
&fieldops; with level 0 battle-sense do not spawn with binoculars
syringes function underwater
pliers function underwater
Level 5 Engineers will spawn with a Bomb. - Looks like a red smoke bomb, but does as much damage as a dynamite and explodes in 4 seconds. Only 1 per life
Level 5 Engineers' landmines inflict +15% damage
Allow Engineer's "Bomb" to damage movers (trucks, tanks, etc.)
"Too many air strikes requested" will restore used charge bar
"Too many air strikes requested" will restore half of used charge bar
ammo packs restore a lost helmet
players with binoculars drop them upon death
allies reload rifles mid-clip to match corresponding axis ability
Enable fast shooting for MP40, Thompson and Sten (delay between rounds lowered from 150ms to 110ms)
Knife can get headshots
Throwing knife can get headshots
enable poison throwing knives
disable adrenaline
